title: Final Fantasy Legend II - Lethal Strike (Romancing SaGa 1 Mix)
description:
A normal battle theme from Final Fantasy Legend II, redone with the instruments of Romancing SaGa on SNES. Based on the DS remake, Goddess of Destiny.

This port uses the optimized SMW sample set.
